channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Healthy lifestyle tied to lower infection risk in type 2 diabetes
item.description: Following a healthy lifestyle is linked to about a 44% lower rate of infections in type 2 diabetes patients.

item.title: Trump and RFK Jr.'s health industry deals unenforced, may disappear
item.description: During a competitive Michigan reelection race, Rep. Tom Barrett joined HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy to discuss health industry commitments that remain unenforced.

item.title: Venetoclax linked to worse outcomes in double-hit lymphoma
item.description: A phase 2 trial examined adding venetoclax to chemoimmunotherapy for newly diagnosed double-hit lymphoma, finding it did not improve outcomes.

item.title: Family cancer history raises IBD colorectal cancer risk
item.description: IBD patients with multiple close relatives who had colorectal cancer face a significantly higher risk of developing the disease.
